abilities.name: Magical Journey
notes: Bard can cast Magical Journey while grounded or rooted.
Any abilities that continue during normal movement, such as point blank area of effects and various forms of stealth, will continue during the travel within Magical Journey.
If a champion's dash is interrupted while inside terrain using Magical Journey, they will be immediately displaced out to the nearest open space, but are not rendered airborne.
Taking Magical Journey is considered a dash, and so will interact with effects such as Sudden Impact and knockdown.

abilities.name: Traveler's Call

evidence.quote: * At 5 Chimes, Meeps slow damaged enemies by 25 / 35 / 45 / 55 / 65 / 75 (based on number of Chimes)% for 1 second.

notes: Only Meep cone attacks are absorbed by spell shields. Those that deal damage together with the basic attack don't.
If a Meep empowered auto attack is dodged, blocked or when Bard is blinded, the basic attack itself will deal no damage, but the Meep damage will still be applied.

abilities.name: Cosmic Binding

evidence.quote: Active: Bard fires an energy bolt in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and slows them by 60% for a duration.
If the bolt hits terrain or a second enemy, it stuns both targets for the same duration, dealing the same damage to the secondary target.

applies.condition: If the bolt hits terrain or a second enemy, it stuns both targets for the same duration, dealing the same damage to the secondary target.

notes:
Cosmic Binding's interaction with spell shields:
  - If the first target has a spell shield, they will block the damage but the bolt will still pass through them.
    - If the bolt hits a second target, only they will be stunned.
    - If the bolt hits terrain, the first target will be stunned.
  - If the second target has a spell shield, they will block the stun and damage.
    - The first target will still be stunned.
  - If the first target gains a spell shield after being hit, the stun will not be blocked.
The stun will apply even if the first target becomes untargetable.
The stun is still applied even if the first or second target dies to the ability itself or before the projectile can bind them.

abilities.name: Tempered Fate

evidence.quote: Upon impact, it puts all units within into stasis for 2.5 seconds, as well as stunning all enemy champions, minions, and turrets struck for the same duration.
Upon impact, it puts all units within into stasis for 2.5 seconds, as well as stunning all enemy champions, minions, and turrets struck for the same duration.

notes:
Tempered Fate's stun is affected by Tenacity.
  - The stasis is unaffected.

Tempered Fate has no effect on enemies that have displacement immunity or total crowd control immunity, and allies that are immune from using an ability that preloads UnstoppableForceMarker.
  - The only exceptions are the crowd control immunity that turrets and epic monsters have.

All champions (including allies) during the stasis are prohibited from activating cleansing effects for its duration.
  - It will not disable Quicksilver and instead put it on a 3-second cooldown.

Tempered Fate deals 0 proc true damage, which triggers in-combat effects such as drawing turret and monster aggression, Sudden Impact or applying Elixir of Sorcery.
  - Elixir of Sorcery deals damage before the target is put into stasis.
Stasis is applied to allies as a buff.
